body.name: Degeneracy-aware one-arc semialgebraic certificate
body.construction: For fixed rational observed summaries and rational finite budgets, \(\mathsf{CERT}\) first treats \(\Gamma_A=1\) and \(\Gamma_0=\Gamma_1=1\) as the point-identified cases.  Otherwise it sets \(W_{\Gamma_A}(t)=\Gamma_A t/\{1+(\Gamma_A-1)t\}\) and evaluates only the canonical reverse-arc objectives \(H_x^-(W_{\Gamma_A}(t),t)\) and \(H_x^+(W_{\Gamma_A}(t),t)\) for \(t\in[0,1]\); the forward arc is represented by complementing \(U\) and is not enumerated separately.  The procedure treats each \(\Gamma_a=1\) branch separately, adjoins the legal quadratic-root variables for nontrivial arms, evaluates \(t=0,1\) as the constant-\(U\) corners, saturates every stationary ideal by all cleared denominators, legal-root derivatives, and branch-boundary polynomials, isolates generic zero-dimensional stationary candidates by iterated resultants and Sturm sequences, and validates every isolated candidate against the original equations and inequalities by rational interval Newton tests.  An identically vanishing resultant, a legal-root collision, or a positive-dimensional stationary continuum is passed to cylindrical algebraic decomposition rather than discarded.  For the fixed input, \(\mathsf{CERT}\) returns real-algebraic endpoint values, rational isolating intervals, and exact membership certificates; it does not return a symbolic atlas over varying inputs.
